probes.summary: Read-only routing and PostgreSQL/Patroni role checks completed on all four nodes.
limitations: The initial direct VyOS show invocation was unavailable in the exec shell; the supported wrapper invocation succeeded.

probes.summary: Created evaluator-owned data on node2, read identical rows from node3 and node4, then removed and confirmed cleanup.
The node1 audit completed, but the managed lease expired before the remaining operational-state checks could run.
limitations: Managed-cluster lease expired on the first Probe 3 node2 exec; no further exec calls were made.

assertions.summary: VyOS routes both private LANs; node2 is the sole primary and node3/node4 are streaming replicas over LAN addresses with active Patroni services.

evidence.command: sudo -n /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper show interfaces; sudo -n /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper show ip route

printf '%s
' '===ADDR==='; ip -4 -br addr; printf '%s
' '===ROUTE==='; ip -4 route; printf '%s
' '===SERVICES==='; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend --no-pager | grep -Ei 'postgres|patroni|repmgr|pgpool|keepalived|pacemaker|corosync|ha' || true; printf '%s
' '===PG==='; sudo -n -u postgres -- psql -X -d appdb -Atc "select 'server='||coalesce(inet_server_addr()::text,'local')||':'||coalesce(inet_server_port()::text,'0'), 'recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery(), 'appdb='||(current_database() = 'appdb'), 'replication_clients='||(select count(*) from pg_stat_replication);"
evidence.observation: node2 has management 10.100.98.11/24 and LAN-A 10.100.121.11/24; route to 10.100.51.0/24 via 10.100.121.254; patroni and haproxy active; recovery=false, appdb=true, replication_clients=2.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -- psql -X -d postgres -P pager=off -F '|' -Atc "select application_name,client_addr::text,state,sync_state,write_lag,flush_lag,replay_lag from pg_stat_replication order by application_name;"
evidence.observation: node3|10.100.51.11/32|streaming|sync and node4|10.100.51.12/32|streaming|async, with sub-second replication lag.

evidence.observation: WAL receiver reports 10.100.121.11:5432, streaming, slot node3; established connection is 10.100.51.11 to 10.100.121.11:5432.

evidence.observation: WAL receiver reports 10.100.121.11:5432, streaming, slot node4; established connection is 10.100.51.12 to 10.100.121.11:5432.

assertions.summary: The evaluator schema contained three committed rows on node2, and both recovering replicas returned the identical ordered dataset.

evidence.command: schema="evaluator_$(date +%s%N)"; printf 'admin_identity='; id -un; printf ' schema=%s\n' "$schema"; sudo -n -u postgres -- psql --version; sudo -n -u postgres -- psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v schema="$schema" -d appdb -c "create schema \"$schema\"; create table \"$schema\".replication_rows (seq integer primary key, payload text not null); insert into \"$schema\".replication_rows(seq,payload) values (1,'evaluator-row-alpha'),(2,'evaluator-row-beta'),(3,'evaluator-row-gamma'); commit; select current_database(), count(*) from \"$schema\".replication_rows;"; printf 'EVALUATOR_SCHEMA=%s\n' "$schema"
evidence.observation: sudo PostgreSQL access succeeded; schema evaluator_1787922429478381024 was created in appdb, INSERT 0 3 completed, and appdb count=3. PostgreSQL emitted a harmless no-transaction-in-progress warning for the explicit COMMIT after autocommit.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -- psql -X -d appdb -P pager=off -F '|' -Atc "select 'recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery()||' read_only='||current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'); select seq,payload from \"evaluator_1787922429478381024\".replication_rows order by seq;"
evidence.observation: recovery=true; returned 1|evaluator-row-alpha, 2|evaluator-row-beta, 3|evaluator-row-gamma.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -- psql -X -d appdb -P pager=off -F '|' -Atc "select 'recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery()||' read_only='||current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'); select seq,payload from \"evaluator_1787922429478381024\".replication_rows order by seq;"
evidence.observation: recovery=true; returned 1|evaluator-row-alpha, 2|evaluator-row-beta, 3|evaluator-row-gamma.

assertions.summary: Node1 showed no failed units and a coherent filtered VyOS configuration, but the lease expired before the database-node state audits could execute.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '===FAILED_UNITS==='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true; printf '%s
' '===SAVED_VYOS_CONFIG_FILTERED==='; sudo -n /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper show configuration commands | grep -E '^set (interfaces|protocols static|firewall|nat|service)' | grep -Ev 'password|secret|key|certificate' || true; printf '%s
' '===LIVE_ROUTE==='; ip -4 route; printf '%s
' '===LISTENERS==='; sudo -n ss -lntup
evidence.observation: No failed units. Saved config contains LAN interfaces 10.100.121.254/24 and 10.100.51.254/24, default-drop forwarding with explicit PostgreSQL/Patroni/etcd/HAProxy LAN rules, and matching live routes. Listeners were VyOS daemons, DHCP, and SSH.

limitations: The managed exec call for the first database-node operational audit returned `Mcp error -32000: The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired` before execution; remaining live checks are therefore indeterminate.

actions_performed: Executed Probe 1 read-only topology checks on node1 through node4.
Used protected local PostgreSQL access via sudo on node2 to create evaluator_1787922429478381024 with three rows, then queried node3 and node4 independently.
Dropped only the evaluator schema on node2 and independently confirmed its absence on node2, node3, and node4.
Stopped all live checking after lease expiry and made no further exec calls.
overall_summary: The required topology and evaluator data replication assertions pass. The operational-state cleanliness assertion is indeterminate because the managed lease expired before the database-node audits. Evidence collection is closed.
